'''Keredians'''<ref name="FA" /> were a [[species]] of [[humanoid]]s whose members were thinly spread around the [[galaxy]]. Little information existed about them, including their [[homeworld]].<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> Initially some of the Keredian race joined the [[Partisans]] but after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] [[Jedha City]], they joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to continue their fight against the tyranny of the Empire.<ref name="FA" /> One such member of this race was [[Cycyed Ock]], who used a [[vibrorang]] as his weapon.<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Ruk]] was also a Keredian who was a member of the [[Tech Masters]].<ref name="Luke & Leia Adventure" /> Other Keredians were much more apathetic to the civil war, with a Keredian named [[Dewi Pamular]] working as a [[squiggly]] [[fisher]] along with an [[alien]] named [[Freedi Pamular]]<ref name="DOF">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref> on the [[moon]]<ref name="Narkina 5 Audio">Per the Audio Description for "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]" available on [[Disney+]].</ref> [[Narkina 5]]<ref name="DOF" /> in [[5 BBY]]<ref name="5 BBY date">[[Dewi Pamular]] appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' episode "[[Daughter of Ferrix]]" takes place shortly after "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," which {{SW|url=andor-s1-e8-trivia-gallery|text="Narkina 5" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}} dates to [[5 BBY]].</ref> which they visited using an old [[TUG-b13]] quadjumper. Dewi Pamular still shared their species' hatred for the Empire, though, and happily assisted [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and [[Ruescott Melshi]], at the time fugitives from the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]], escape the moon aboard their starship.<ref name="DOF" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Keredian species were first introduced in the mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Force Arena]]'', after its 1.5 update on [[April 5]], [[2017]].<ref name="Source">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mobirum.com/article/detail?cafeId=StarWarsForceArena&bbsId=1571&id=770837|text=Star Wars™: Force Arena 1.5 Update Details|archivedate=20170430185810}}</ref>
